## ggplot2
we are using a ToothGrowth data-set for practicing ggplot2 because it contains numerical and categorical variables

## Load and explore the ToothGrowth dataset

```{r}
data("ToothGrowth")
View(ToothGrowth)
head(ToothGrowth)
str(ToothGrowth)
summary(ToothGrowth)
```
## Understanding the dataset

the dataset contains 60 observations from an experiment investigating how different vitamin c delivery methods and doses affect tooth growth in guinea pigs.

variable  Description                           data type
len       Tooth Length                          Numeric
supp      Supplement type(OJ or VC)             Categorical
dose      Vitamin C dosage(0.5,1 or 2 mg/day)   Numeric

OJ: orange Juice
VC: Ascrobic acid(Vitamin c)



## practising ggplot2 functions
we first have to install the package and we load it using library function. 
```{r}
install.packages(c("ggplot2"))
library(ggplot2)
```
## 1. geom_bar()
Count the number of observations for each supplement type.
```{r}
ggplot(ToothGrowth,aes(x = supp)) + geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") + labs( title = "Number of Guinea pigs by supplement type", x = "Supplement Type", y = "frequency") + theme_minimal()
```
## 2. geom_boxplot()
Compare tooth length across supplement types.
```{r}
ggplot(ToothGrowth, aes(x=supp,y=len)) + geom_boxplot(fill = "orange") + labs(title="Tooth length by supplement Type", x = "Supplement Type", y = "Tooth length") + theme_classic()
```

## 3. geom_density()
Visualize the distribution of tooth lengths.

```{r}
ggplot(ToothGrowth,aes(x=len,fill=supp)) + geom_density(alpha=0.5)+ labs(title = "distribution of tooth length", x="tooth length", y="density") + theme_dark()
```
## 4. geom_histogram
Display the frequency distribution of tooth length.

```{r}
ggplot(ToothGrowth,aes(x=len))+ geom_histogram(bins = 15, fill = "skyblue", color="black") + labs(title = "Distribution of Tooth length", x="tooth lenght", y = "frequency") + theme_classic()
```


## 5. geom_hline()

Display the frequency distribution of tooth length.

```{r}
ggplot(ToothGrowth, aes(x = dose, y = len)) +
  geom_point() + geom_hline( yintercept = mean(ToothGrowth$len), color = "red",linetype = "dashed" ) +labs( title = "Tooth Length by Vitamin C Dosage", x = "Dosage (mg/day)", y = "Tooth Length") +
  theme_bw()
```

## 6. geom_jitter
Display individual tooth length observations by supplement type.

```{r}
ggplot(ToothGrowth, aes(x = supp, y = len)) + geom_jitter( color = "purple", width = 0.15, size = 2 ) + labs( title = "Tooth Length Observations by Supplement", x = "Supplement Type", y = "Tooth Length" ) + theme_minimal()
```

## 7. geom_line
Show how average tooth length changes with dosage for each supplement.
```{r}
ggplot(ToothGrowth, aes( x = dose, y = len, color = supp, group = supp )) + stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1) + labs( title = "Average Tooth Growth by Vitamin C Dosage", x = "Dosage (mg/day)", y = "Average Tooth Length", color = "Supplement" ) + theme_minimal()
```

## 8. geom_point
Explore the relationship between dosage and tooth length.

```{r}
ggplot(ToothGrowth, aes(x = dose, y = len)) + geom_point(color = "blue", size = 3) + labs( title = "Vitamin C Dosage vs Tooth Length", x = "Dosage (mg/day)", y = "Tooth Length") + theme_minimal()
```

## 9.geom_rug
Show the individual tooth length observations along the axis.

```{r}
ggplot(ToothGrowth, aes(x = len)) + geom_density(fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.5) + geom_rug(color = "red") + labs( title = "Tooth Length Distribution with Rug Marks", x = "Tooth Length", y = "Density" ) + theme_minimal()
```

## 10. geom_smooth
Show the trend between vitamin C dosage and tooth length.
```{r}
ggplot(ToothGrowth, aes(x = dose, y = len)) + geom_point() + geom_smooth( method = "lm", color = "red" ) + labs( title = "Trend Between Dosage and Tooth Length", x = "Dosage (mg/day)", y = "Tooth Length") + theme_minimal()
```

## 11. geom_text
Label individual observations with their supplement type.

```{r}
ggplot(ToothGrowth, aes(x = dose, y = len))  + geom_text( aes(label = supp), vjust = -0.8, size = 3) +labs(title = "Tooth Length with Supplement Labels",x = "Dosage (mg/day)",y = "Tooth Length") +theme_minimal()
```

## 12. geom_violin
Compare the distribution of tooth length for each supplement.

```{r}
ggplot(ToothGrowth, aes(x = supp, y = len)) + geom_violin(fill = "lightgreen") + labs(title = "Tooth Length Distribution by Supplement",x = "Supplement Type",y = "Tooth Length") + theme_minimal()
```

## 13. geom_vline()

```{r}
ggplot(ToothGrowth, aes(x = dose, y = len)) + geom_point() + geom_vline( xintercept = mean(ToothGrowth$dose), color = "red",linetype = "dashed") +labs( title = "Tooth Length by Vitamin C Dosage", x = "Dosage (mg/day)", y = "Tooth Length") +theme_minimal()
```
